classes.contract: Only from a contract written to produce it.
classes.impractical: Possible in principle, only past a limit no real or local ledger reaches.
classes.local_core: Producible by a local stellar-core scenario: a failure or shape that depends on ledger state.
classes.never_in_ledger: Cannot be in a closed ledger: set only by a check that a transaction failing it never gets past, only on a stellar-core bug, or only in a form a ledger never stores.
classes.upgrade: Only in a ledger that applies a network upgrade; producible by a local scenario that arms it.
